signal: Nextech debuted its Cora AI assistant and was named in the 2026 Best in KLAS report, with EDGE 2026 spotlighting new AI and payments capabilities.

email.body1:
Josh, saw Nextech earned a 2026 Best in KLAS spot and spotlighted the new Cora AI assistant at EDGE this spring.

For a regional sales leader, that recognition usually means more practices raising their hand than your reps can work before they go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your territory gets covered without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your region's number
email.body2:
Josh, quick follow-up on Nextech's region.

The KLAS recognition and Cora launch tend to create demand faster than reps can ramp, so coverage gaps show up late in the quarter and quota gets harder to defend.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Josh, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other specialty health-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Josh, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a product and awards push, timing is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region's motion? I will tailor it to Nextech either way.
